name: steps
title: Steps
description: Steps that open one at a time: the one to do is the only open thing, a finished step folds to a line that says what came of it, and a step not reached is dimmed and locked.
use_for: A short job done in order on one page, such as sending data by API or setting up single sign-on.
never: Steps that could be done in any order
body:
`useSteps()` keeps the state: `state(n)` for each Step, `reach(n)` when a step is done (it opens the next), `toggle(n)`
on a head's `open`, `reset()` to start again.

elements.name: Step
elements.description: One step: a numbered head that opens its body when it is the step to do.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The step's title (Vue's `title`; `title` is HTML's tooltip attribute).

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: now (open), done, todo (reached, folded) or next (locked).

attributes.name: says
attributes.description: What came of it, shown while folded.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.description: What's done can't be undone from here, so its line doesn't open.

attributes.name: leaving
attributes.description: The body stays in the page while it folds away (Vue's leaving <Transition>).
